name: Telegram
description: Message the tasks you connect to Telegram from your phone, and let them answer you there.

fields.label: Bot token
fields.help: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token

fields.label: Allowed user IDs
fields.placeholder: Filled in when you press Start
fields.help: Numeric Telegram user IDs, separated by commas. Leave empty to pair your account by pressing Start in Telegram.

fields.label: Home chat ID
fields.help: Where a task's message goes when it names no chat. Pairing sets it to your private chat.

disclosure: Messages that allowed Telegram users send your bot reach the tasks you connect to Telegram.
Connected tasks can reply, edit, react and send files as your bot.
Photos, voice messages and files sent to the bot are downloaded to this computer.
The bot token stays on this computer; Telegram still delivers the bot's messages through its servers.
